reason:
Cause is hard-cap at round 4, the Discussion-Review hard cap of 4, so accept is the only option. Five findings tagged design-wrong are still open: F2 to F6. The round-4 fixer answered each one in the decision record now in place, and I checked each answer against the code.
F2: move in internal/fabricengine/originreconcilemoves.go:357 returns at needsMove before it calls pairLive (line 374), as the finding says. D5 step 1 (decision-record.md:108-110) now has adopt call LivePair of its own OriginSeams for every named owned_elsewhere slug with a local pair. The seams exist (internal/pairteardown/originseams.go:24,73), and the line-243 criterion names the hub-only HubPaused test.
F3: finalizeEnteredRead counts a Finalize history row as entered (internal/fabricengine/replay.go:259), and withoutFinalizeEntered drops such a slug (replay.go:312). D6 now says this plainly, says the step 2b records commit is replayed, has the halt note name `lyx fabric remove <slug>` and leave the pause standing, and lists the leftover batten record under Open risks.
F4: D6 now names a second signal, the child's inner status at CurrentProducer Finalize, either running or failed with a non-empty Transient, with no restep settle record. Those fields exist (internal/shedengine/status.go:134, internal/sheddriver/drive.go:269), InnerRun already reads that status (internal/battenshed/innerrun.go:62), and the release row for a stopped Finalize is in the criteria.
F5: D7 now limits the skip to the driver's in-process re-step, sends a Spawn re-entry to D3's refusal, and states that the skip also covers the unreachable-origin halt.
F6: the halt note now lists the local parent commits origin lacks, advises the reset only when the squash is the only one, and otherwise advises the rebase --onto.
The mechanical BLOCKING F1 is fixed too: the PATTERN-owner-machine text and the Goal now match D2 for unowned entries.
No finding is wrong, but the fix in place answers each one. I recorded the accept, so the segment passes unconverged on round 4.
